item.title: Version 1.1.15
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.15

  • Earnings Calendar State Persistence: Automatically remembers your selected filter (All, Portfolios, Watchlists) and active inspector symbol across tab switches and app relaunches.
  • Refined Earnings Layout & Metrics: Dedicated Net Income and profit margin column, flexible table widths to eliminate right-edge clipping, and clear EPS Actual vs Estimate consensus labels.
  • Comprehensive Localization & Terminology: Unified Buy Target indicators and completed full Vietnamese localization across Earnings, Sidebar, and Settings.
  • Watchlist & Detail Performance: Optimized symbol detail sheet opening and background data fetching for instantaneous response.
